serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: But I promise I will get the whole sum soon!
Landlord: Forget it! Do you know how many times I have heard one of these sad stories? Thousands! 
Landlord: If someone is late with one payment, he’s gonna be late with the next one too. That’s just common knowledge in this business.
You: Oh come on man, don’t be like that!
Landlord: You just don’t get it, do you?{{wi}} YOU ARE OUT! FUCKING OUT! GET THE HELL OUT OF HERE AND TAKE YOUR BITCH WITH YOU!
Landlord: You have an hour, when I come back, you better be out of here.
